lead.headline: Northern Arizona came within a point of Kentucky
lead.deck: The Lumberjacks were 30.5-point underdogs in Lexington and lost 78-77. Montana State rates highest in the league.
body: Hardwood Bricks now covers the Big Sky, 11 schools from Cheney and Missoula down to Flagstaff and St. George. Every game gets a preview, a recap, a line history and a spot in our ratings.
Northern Arizona is 0-4, but all four losses came on the road at UNLV, New Mexico, Arizona and Kentucky. Friday in Lexington the Lumberjacks lost 78-77 as 30.5-point underdogs.
Montana State rates highest in the league at 131st, with an 83-70 win over Long Beach State. Montana (163rd) won 80-71 at North Dakota on Saturday.
Portland State won 84-68 at San Francisco on Saturday as an 8.5-point underdog.
Southern Utah scored 143 points against Bethesda and 134 against West Coast Baptist, then lost by 29 at High Point and by 38 at Wake Forest.

notes.headline: Eastern Washington's trip
notes.body: The Eagles lost at Stanford, Oregon and Oregon State before beating Corban at home.

notes.headline: Weber State's week
notes.body: The Wildcats lost 101-93 at home to Utah Valley, then by 21 at Utah.

notes.headline: Idaho State on the road
notes.body: The Bengals have opened with three road games, at Utah State, Wyoming and Air Force.

notes.body: The Big Sky tournament in March decides the league's NCAA bid.
